mapper.select:
select t.task_id as taskId, t.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, t.task_title as title, t.task_content as content, t.source_type as sourceType, t.task_type as taskType, t.task_status as taskStatus, case when t.task_status in (0, 1, 2) and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 1 else 0 end as overdueFlag, t.due_time as dueTime, t.create_by as creatorUserId, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime, t.remark, (select a.assignee_user_id from ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment a where a.task_id = t.task_id and a.is_delete = 0 order by a.assignment_id desc limit 1) as assigneeUserId, (select a.assignment_status from ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment a where a.task_id = t.task_id and a.assignee_user_id = #{currentUserId} and a.is_delete = 0 order by a.assignment_id desc limit 1) as assignmentStatus, (select r.score from ry_business.ry_rental_work_review r where r.task_id = t.task_id and r.is_delete = 0 order by r.review_id desc limit 1) as latestScore from ry_business.ry_rental_work_task t left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and w.member_id = t.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.member_id = #{memberId} and t.is_delete = 0
and t.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and ( t.task_status = #{status} or (#{status} = 4 and t.task_status in (0, 1, 2) and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now()) )
and (t.task_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.task_content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by case when t.task_status in (0, 1, 2) and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 0 else 1 end, case when t.due_time is null then 1 else 0 end, t.due_time asc, t.create_time desc, t.task_id desc

select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 0 and not (t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now()) then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 1 and not (t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now()) then 1 else 0 end) as processingCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 2 and not (t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now()) then 1 else 0 end) as reviewCount, sum(case when t.task_status in (0, 1, 2) and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 1 else 0 end) as overdueCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount from ry_business.ry_rental_work_task t where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.member_id = #{memberId} and t.is_delete = 0

select t.task_id as taskId, t.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, t.task_title as title, t.task_content as content, t.source_type as sourceType, t.task_type as taskType, t.task_status as taskStatus, case when t.task_status in (0, 1, 2) and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 1 else 0 end as overdueFlag, t.due_time as dueTime, t.create_by as creatorUserId, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime, t.remark from ry_business.ry_rental_work_task t left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and w.member_id = t.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.member_id = #{memberId} and t.task_id = #{taskId} and t.is_delete = 0

select a.assignment_id as assignmentId, a.task_id as taskId, a.assignee_user_id as assigneeUserId, a.assignment_status as assignmentStatus, a.read_time as readTime, a.assigned_by as assignedBy, a.assigned_time as assignedTime from ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.task_id = #{taskId} and a.is_delete = 0 order by a.assigned_time desc, a.assignment_id desc

select s.submission_id as submissionId, s.task_id as taskId, s.assignment_id as assignmentId, s.submitter_user_id as submitterUserId, s.completion_note as completionNote, s.evidence_json as evidenceJson, s.submitted_time as submittedTime from ry_business.ry_rental_work_submission s where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.member_id = #{memberId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.is_delete = 0 order by s.submitted_time desc, s.submission_id desc

select r.review_id as reviewId, r.task_id as taskId, r.submission_id as submissionId, r.reviewer_user_id as reviewerUserId, r.score, r.review_result as reviewResult, r.review_comment as reviewComment, r.create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_work_review r where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.task_id = #{taskId} and r.is_delete = 0 order by r.create_time desc, r.review_id desc

select assignment_id as assignmentId, task_id as taskId, assignee_user_id as assigneeUserId, assignment_status as assignmentStatus from ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and task_id = #{taskId} and assignee_user_id = #{userId} and is_delete = 0 order by assignment_id desc limit 1 for update

select submission_id as submissionId, task_id as taskId, assignment_id as assignmentId, submitter_user_id as submitterUserId, completion_note as completionNote, evidence_json as evidenceJson, submitted_time as submittedTime from ry_business.ry_rental_work_submission where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and task_id = #{taskId} and is_delete = 0 order by submission_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_work_task (tenant_id, member_id, warehouse_id, task_title, task_content, source_type, task_type, task_status, due_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sourceType}, #{taskType}, 0, #{dueTime}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment (tenant_id, member_id, task_id, assignee_user_id, assignment_status, assigned_by, assigned_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{taskId}, #{assigneeUserId}, 0, #{assignedBy}, now(), #{assignedBy}, now(), #{assignedBy}, now(), 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_work_submission (tenant_id, member_id, task_id, assignment_id, submitter_user_id, completion_note, evidence_json, submitted_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{taskId}, #{assignmentId}, #{submitterUserId}, #{completionNote}, #{evidenceJson}, now(), #{submitterUserId}, now(), #{submitterUserId}, now(), 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_work_review (tenant_id, member_id, task_id, submission_id, reviewer_user_id, score, review_result, review_comment, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{taskId}, #{submissionId}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{score}, #{reviewResult}, #{reviewComment}, #{reviewerUserId}, now(), #{reviewerUserId}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_work_task set task_status = #{toStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and task_id = #{taskId} and task_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment set assignment_status = #{toStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and assignment_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_work_assignment set read_time = coalesce(read_time, now()), update_by = #{userId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and task_id = #{taskId} and assignee_user_id = #{userId} and is_delete = 0
